_meta.purpose: Aggregated brand catalog for configurator tier schema, brand-profile pages, and comparison articles. Built 2026-05-27 from data/brands/<slug>/ research.

tier_definitions.solo: Default brand spec — what we recommend as primary product. Always shown.
tier_definitions.featured: Brands with confirmed IL distribution + technical depth. Shown as alternative on every relevant page.
tier_definitions.alternative: Brands cited as competitive alternatives — shown in comparison context.
tier_definitions.reference: Brands cited for completeness or historical context — not actively promoted.
tier_definitions.diy-alternative: Consumer-DIY brands shown only on residential / hobby-scale pages.

_meta.data_sources: Public manufacturer websites + published TDS PDFs (research-only, not republished). Per-brand source URLs in data/brands/<slug>/sources.md.

brands.name: Sika Flooring
brands.il_distribution: confirmed via Gilar Building Products Ltd. (gilar.co.il)
brands.differentiator: Default reference brand for all industrial floor systems. Most complete portfolio (post-MBCC absorption 2023 also owns Ucrete/MasterTop technical lines). Strongest IL distribution.

brands.name: Topciment
brands.differentiator: Technical microcement specialist with three-tier portfolio (2K Sttandard / 1K Evoluttion / ready-to-use Efectto). Full TDS transparency. Most legible decorative microcement brand for engineering specifications. 19 public TDSs available.

brands.name: Mapei Mapefloor
brands.il_distribution: unconfirmed but active IL presence — importer name needed
brands.differentiator: Italian-design credibility + Bioblock® silver-ion antimicrobial (the brand-unique differentiator vs Sika in healthcare/food spec).

brands.name: Ideal Work
brands.differentiator: Italian design-led decorative microcement, hospitality/residential consultative selling. The aesthetic-pedigree brand in decorative microcement segment.

brands.name: Flowcrete (Tremco CPG)
brands.il_distribution: unknown — MENA via flowcrete.ae channel possible
brands.differentiator: Polygiene® silver-ion antimicrobial integrated into PU-cement matrix — the key argument when food/pharma specs require antimicrobial. Also UK car park deck waterproofing depth.

brands.name: Master Builders Solutions (MasterTop / Ucrete)
brands.il_distribution: presumably via Gilar (same channel as Sika)
brands.differentiator: Historic industry-reference brand for Ucrete PU-cement. Now structurally a Sika sub-brand; brand recognition still high in legacy specifications.

brands.name: Stonhard
brands.il_distribution: unknown — Stonhard's single-source model usually direct international
brands.differentiator: Single-source warranty: same company manufactures + installs + warranties. Unique in industry. Premium pricing justified by warranty consolidation for high-stakes specs.

brands.name: Altro
brands.il_distribution: unknown — likely indirect via specialist FF&E channels
brands.differentiator: Lifetime PTV warranty — slip-resistance guaranteed for life of product (silicon carbide / aluminum oxide through full thickness). Reference brand for healthcare + commercial kitchens.

brands.name: Polyflor
brands.il_distribution: unknown — UK export volumes to IL exist
primary_segments: safety vinyl (Polysafe Apex 55 + 12 other Polysafe SKUs)
brands.differentiator: Price-competitive Altro alternative. Broader decorative range. Same R10–R12 PTV ratings without Altro's lifetime-warranty premium.

brands.name: Smartcret
primary_segments: DIY microcement kits (sized per application area)
brands.differentiator: Public per-m² pricing reference: €47-48/m² materials-only DIY for wall kits → ~₪185-195/m² IL @ 2026 ILS/EUR. The price-floor citation for any microcement pricing article.

brands.name: KEIM Mineral Coatings
brands.il_distribution: owner-named partner — specific stockist to be filled
brands.differentiator: Originator of mineral silicate paint (140+ years). Chemically-bonded coatings vs physical adhesion. Primarily WALL/FACADE specialist — flooring relevance limited to restoration crossover and decorative interior schemes.
brands.note: NOT primarily a flooring brand — included due to owner partner status. Position on FloorDSGN as wall/facade companion for crossover projects, not floor competitor.

brands.name: Mortex (BEAL)
brands.differentiator: Belgian originator of décor mortar-based wet-area finish (béton ciré). 1mm waterproof from 1 layer. Reference brand for premium wet bathroom / shower microcement.
